stories.title: Doctors said he’d never walk again. Then, he finished a marathon
stories.summary: Doctors told James McGinnis he would never walk again after a brain bleed during a high school football game. Eleven years later, he finished a marathon.

stories.title: What to know before using gamified credit card rewards
stories.summary: Some new credit cards turn every swipe into a spin of the wheel with random cashback. NerdWallet's Sara Rathner explains the risks and what to look for.

stories.title: Nationwide Emergency Alert System test to take place Tuesday. Here’s what will happen
stories.summary: FEMA and the FCC will conduct a nationwide Emergency Alert System test Tuesday at 2:20 p.m. Eastern time. The test message will last one minute.

stories.title: How to talk with older family members about driving
stories.summary: As people age, their health changes, and families can face the question of when a loved one should stop driving. Here are tips on how to talk about it.

stories.title: Legally blind hitting coach has trained young athletes for 40 years
